description: Backend: after phase 1 (PROBLEM_IDENTIFICATION) analysis, produce an explicit, actionable Spanish list of the specific information/data the user should collect for the next phase, and expose it in the submit-input result and workflow status so the frontend can render it. Design = Option A: enhance the phase-1 AI response so it returns BOTH the identified problem AND a 'Informacion que debes recopilar' bullet list. This is a self-contained backend feature; the frontend rendering is FEAT-002.
steps: Update ANALYZE_PROBLEM_PROMPT in backend/app/core/prompts.py so the model returns a structured response in Spanish with TWO clearly separated sections: (1) the identified problem (as today), and (2) a section titled exactly 'Informacion que debes recopilar' containing an explicit markdown bullet list (- item) of the specific data/instruments the user should gather to bring to the next phase. Keep it actionable and concrete (what to measure, from whom, with which instrument). Preserve the existing {knowledge_context} placeholder and the 'Responde en espanol' guidance.

In backend/app/services/workflow_engine.py process_input(), PROBLEM_IDENTIFICATION branch: the full analyze_problem() text is the AI response. Add a new result key 'collection_suggestions' so the frontend can render the recollection guidance as its own list, in addition to the existing 'identified_problem'. Since analyze_problem() returns a single combined markdown string, set result['collection_suggestions'] to that full markdown string (the frontend will render it as a markdown list via AIResponse) OR, if you split, keep result['identified_problem'] as before and put the recollection section text in result['collection_suggestions']. Choose the simplest robust approach: keep result['identified_problem'] = ai_response (unchanged) AND set result['collection_suggestions'] = ai_response so the guidance list is always available to render. Ensure the graceful-degradation path (ai_unconfigured / ai_error) still sets collection_suggestions to '' and does not break, following the existing pattern that sets result['ai_response'] = ''.

Confirm submit_input in backend/app/routers/workflow.py returns the full result dict (it already returns result) and get_workflow_status returns phase_result = state.phase_data[current_phase] (it already does), so no router change is needed unless a field is stripped; verify collection_suggestions survives serialization in phase_data.

Add backend tests in backend/tests/test_workflow.py: (a) test that process_input for PROBLEM_IDENTIFICATION populates result['collection_suggestions'] (non-empty string equal to the mocked analyze_problem output) alongside result['identified_problem']; (b) test that when the AI is unconfigured (AIServiceConfigError) result['collection_suggestions'] == '' and no exception is raised and can_advance() is True; (c) test that when a configured AI call fails (generic Exception) result['collection_suggestions'] == '' and result['ai_error'] is True. Use the existing mock_ai_service / MagicMock fixtures and patterns already in the file.

Add/adjust a backend test in backend/tests/test_ai_service.py or test_workflow.py asserting the ANALYZE_PROBLEM_PROMPT text includes the phrase 'Informacion que debes recopilar' (import ANALYZE_PROBLEM_PROMPT from app.core.prompts and assert the phrase is present) so the prompt contract is locked in.
acceptance_criteria: ANALYZE_PROBLEM_PROMPT instructs the model to output an explicit Spanish bullet list under a 'Informacion que debes recopilar' section in addition to the identified problem.
process_input() for PROBLEM_IDENTIFICATION returns a result dict containing both 'identified_problem' and a non-empty 'collection_suggestions' when the AI succeeds.
When the AI is unconfigured or the call fails, process_input() returns 'collection_suggestions' == '' with the appropriate advisory flag and does NOT raise (can_advance() remains True).
Running `cd backend && python3 -m pytest tests/ -q` passes all tests including the new ones.
verification: cd backend && python3 -m pytest tests/test_workflow.py tests/test_ai_service.py -v
cd backend && python3 -m pytest tests/ -q  (full backend suite still green)
findings: Implemented Option A, then applied the v1 review fix (server-side split). ANALYZE_PROBLEM_PROMPT instructs the model to output the identified problem PLUS a section titled exactly 'Informacion que debes recopilar' with a markdown bullet list; kept {knowledge_context} and 'Responde en español'. REVIEW FIX: the phase-1 response is no longer aliased to a single blob. Added module-level helper _split_problem_and_suggestions(ai_response) in workflow_engine.py that splits on the 'Informacion que debes recopilar' marker (case-insensitive AND accent-insensitive via _strip_accents; tolerant of markdown heading/bold/list decoration like '## ' or '**...**' via stripping '#*_-: \t'). It returns (problem_text, suggestions_text): problem_text = everything before the marker line (stripped), suggestions_text = the section body AFTER the marker heading line (heading excluded to avoid repeating the frontend heading). FALLBACK: when the marker is absent -> (full_response, ''); when ai_response is '' -> ('', ''). The PROBLEM_IDENTIFICATION branch now sets result['identified_problem'] = problem_text and result['collection_suggestions'] = suggestions_text, so the two blocks never duplicate. DECISION on persistence: project.problem_description.identified_problem now stores the split problem-only text (problem_text or None) rather than the full blob, which keeps _build_project_context clean (downstream phases receive only the problem statement, not the recollection bullets). The degraded-path normalization still forces collection_suggestions='' on ai_unconfigured/ai_error, and problem_text is '' -> identified_problem stays None, preserving prior degraded behavior (test_process_input_degrades_gracefully_when_ai_call_fails still asserts identified_problem is None). Tests: replaced test_process_input_populates_collection_suggestions with test_process_input_splits_problem_and_collection_suggestions (asserts problem has NO bullets/marker and suggestions has ONLY bullets, no problem statement; asserts persisted identified_problem equals split problem-only text) and added test_process_input_missing_marker_fallback (marker omitted -> collection_suggestions=='' and identified_problem==full text). Updated mock_ai_service.analyze_problem to return a realistic combined response with the marker + bullets. Degraded-path tests unchanged and still green. Verification: `python3 -m pytest tests/ -q` -> 95 passed. Frontend rendering handled in FEAT-002. Did not commit/push per orchestrator instruction.
